title: Studio apartment
goal: A reader must be able to see sleeping, cooking, and living functions in one compact room with a separate bathroom.

rubric.must: One large labeled studio room contains the bed, living furniture, and kitchen equipment.
A separate enclosed bathroom with a door, toilet, sink, and shower is visible.
The displayed room areas add up to less than 30 square metres.
The main studio space has no interior partitions dividing its sleeping, living, and cooking areas.
The entry door opens into clear floor space without striking furniture.
Windows are visible on the outside walls of both the studio and bathroom.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the picture: The picture better satisfies the blockers with recognizable studio furnishings and an enclosed bathroom containing a door, toilet, sink, and shower, although it lacks area figures and a bathroom window.
